title: The Sun Sets in Tangerine Fields
subtitle_source: subs_resolved/0924.txt (371 dialogue lines, full transcript read)
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Inspector Megure, Detective Takagi) omitted by convention; Ran and Sonoko are kept as person nodes because they are the sole on-scene witnesses to the staged fall and Sonoko physically re-enacts/discovers the hiding trick, per the established convention of keeping guest-role recurring characters when they carry real evidentiary weight (cf. ep658). case_type: murder. Correction vs. old low-fidelity case file (cases/ep924_the_sun_sets_in_tangerine_fields.json): the culprit id itself was already correct (Nobuko), but the old file's single 'rigs the trolley' event collapsed and mischaracterized the crime -- the transcript shows the actual cause of death was a premeditated hammer blow (the monorail/container trick was staged purely to fake an accidental fall afterward, not the killing method itself), Nobuko's rage was based on a misunderstanding (she wrongly believed Tetsuji was selling the farm to cover an affair debt, when she herself had originally proposed the sale), and the old file entirely omitted Naoya's false confession (he took the blame for his mother out of guilt before she cut in and confessed the truth herself) as well as the two witnesses (Ran, Sonoko) and the hammer as murder weapon.

attrs.mechanism: bottoms and sides fold so three ordinary containers merge into one, creating a compartment on the monorail's cargo bed large enough to hide an adult

clues.desc: Blood found inside Tetsuji's hat but none on the outside -- contradicts a fatal rock strike during the fall, since the head wound had to predate the hat coming off.
Witnesses saw Tetsuji raise his arm high overhead to wave, but he had a frozen shoulder that made raising it that high impossible -- someone else was moving his arm from a hidden position.

Tetsuji's footprints on the monorail bed only fit an awkward, cramped sitting posture, and nearby containers can fold to merge three into one -- proving a person-sized hidden compartment existed on the cart.

edges.detail: hid inside a merged/folded tangerine container on the monorail's cargo bed, manipulated the already-dead Tetsuji's arm to fake a wave at the witnesses below, then pushed the body off as the monorail passed
rode the monorail's automatic return trip back to the foot shed to escape unseen after staging the fall
broke down and admitted the killing to Naoya on the way to the shed, after he mentioned the farm-sale plan to her
falsely confessed to the murder and to staging the monorail accident himself, out of guilt for having told her about the sale plan
